designOrigin: Frozen before any Trial 31 economic output was observed. Trial 30 showed the proactive collateral architecture fixes the isolated-margin/gap-risk defect but BTC/ETH carry collapsed to roughly 1% annualized in the untouched 2026 holdout. Trial 32 changes the asset basket rather than rescuing BTC/ETH: it uses a fixed equal-weight basket of four liquid non-BTC/ETH perpetuals (SOL, DOGE, AVAX, LINK), selected ex ante without querying their Trial 32 development or final funding-spread economics. The 90% notional setting was already frozen independently in Trial 31 before Trial 30 results.
hypothesis: Cross-venue funding dislocations are heterogeneous across assets; a fixed liquid altcoin basket can preserve the robust proactive collateral mechanics while producing a higher and more persistent Binance-versus-Hyperliquid funding spread than BTC/ETH, including in 2026.

finalHoldout.accessRule: Final market rows and economics may be observed only after every frozen development gate passes.

strategy.direction: always long Binance perpetual and short equal-coin Hyperliquid perpetual
strategy.proactiveCollateralTriggerRule: After realized price/funding PnL at each 8h boundary, fail actual 5% maintenance first. If either venue lacks a 10%-of-notional reserve above a 20% adverse unilateral gap plus 5% maintenance, equalize sleeve capital to 45% Binance / 45% Hyperliquid / 10% cash at the frozen transfer cost before applying hypothetical stress.

fundingClock.hyperliquid: Use raw Hyperliquid fundingHistory settlement/publication event time; sum records in (previous 8h boundary,current boundary], do not backdate or interpolate.
fundingClock.causality: Only actually settled funding cash is booked.

antiRescueRule: After the first Trial 32 development economic output, no scientific parameter, asset, notional, stress buffer, collateral target, transfer cost, clock rule, or gate may change under Trial 32.
